Turn our committed analytics bet into a capability map with Wardley stages and a build-only sequence.
Before we design screens for the home-care scheduling product, ground it in how carers actually plan their visits and where naive tools fail.
Draw the MVP scope boundary for our recipe-planning app and list what we're explicitly leaving out.
Walk me through a lean canvas for our developer-tools initiative so we end up with an initiative brief.

Help me state the outcome and the opportunity behind adding shared workspaces before anyone writes a spec.
We're about to build saved filters. What single assumption would sink it, and what's the cheapest way to test it?
Our de-risked reporting intent is too big for one spec. Break it into child intents.
I've got a half-formed idea about team goals. How much shaping does it need, and which route should we take?
Take a raw idea for a peer-tutoring marketplace through a full discovery to a ratified decision brief.
Record this already-agreed outcome as a minimum repository intent: cut failed card payments by a third.
Write a spec for adding dark mode to the settings page.
Is the new SSO feature delivered across all six of our component repos? Roll up the status in the value-stream meta-repo.
